DESCRIPTION: Plays a track or adds it to the queue
EXAMPLES:
play query:Never Gonna Give You Up
play query:https://music.yandex.ru/album/1/track/2
play query:Rick Astley source:ym next:True
QUERY: Title or link (YouTube, Yandex Music, Spotify, SoundCloud...)
SOURCE: Where to search (YouTube Music by default)
NEXT: Play right after the current track?
NO_LINK: This message doesn't contain any links
NO_VOICE_CHANNEL: You must be in a voice channel
NOT_SAME_CHANNEL: You must be in the same voice channel as me
NODE_UNAVAILABLE: Music server is unavailable right now, try again later
ADDED_PLAYLIST: Added {{count}} tracks from [{{name}}](<{{url}}>) to the queue
STOP_EMPTY: Everyone left the voice channel, so I stopped the music
